questions.stem: Various indices have been developed for identification to avoid subjective errors during the examination of the skeleton. The cephalic index is related to the determination of:
questions.solutionHtml:

questions.stem: Various indices are nowadays used to determine the sex of skeletal remains, especially, the sternum, pelvis and sacrum. Which of the following index is more in males compared to females?
questions.solutionHtml:
Corporobasal index

Corporobasal index of sacrum: -

  • The breadth of the first sacral vertebra x 100 is divided by the Breadth of the base of the sacrum.
  • Its value is 45 in males and 40.5 in females.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 34th Edition, Page Number: 60 & 35th Edition, Page Number: 44- 46

questions.stem: After the age of 25 years when all the long bone epiphyses are fused, skull suture and symphysis changes are used for age estimation. Which of the skull sutures fuses the earliest?
questions.solutionHtml:
Metopic
  • The metopic suture closes about the third year, but in 5 to I0% of cases, it persists.
  • The basioccipital fuses with the basisphenoid at about 18 to 21 years.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 34th Edition, Page Number: 88 & 35th Edition, Page Number: 54,55

questions.stem: A humerus is brought for examination by a police officer which has a length of 30 cm. What would have been the estimated height of the individual?
questions.solutionHtml:
150 cm
  • Height of humerus= length of long bone* multiplication factor of humerus; 30*5.3= 159



The Essentials of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd Edition, Page Number: 654, KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page Number: 498

questions.stemHtml: The following skull is seen in:
questions.solutionHtml:
Negros
  • NEGRO (BLACK): The lower face projects forward (facial Prognathism), the skull narrow and elongated, the orbits square, the nasal aperture broad, and nasal sill guttered, the palate rectangular, and upper and lower limbs longer.
  • Brachycephaly is due to the fusion of coronal sutures. Dolichocephaly is due to the fusion of the sagittal sutures.



The Essentials of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 34th Edition, Page Number: 57,KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology 35th Edition, Page Number: 42
